name: Asaki, Yumemishi ~Hitotose~
original_name: あさき、ゆめみし～ひととせ～
source:
From MIO’s first title, Asaki, Yumemishi, comes a sweet and slightly quirky story of a year spent with the popular characters Takatora Toshimitsu and Iori Shuuichirou. 

Enjoy two novel-style stories—one for Takatora and one for Shuuichirou—as they navigate the seasons of love. 


-- Takatora’s Route: School Life with a Younger Lover 

Having overcome hardships to be together, Takatora and the protagonist are now a couple. 

What does Takatora’s happy life look like as he enjoys a lovey-dovey school life with his beloved senpai (while fending off her meddling familiar and cousin)? 


-- Shuuichirou’s Route: Cohabitation with an Older Lover 

After two years apart, Shuuichirou and the protagonist start living together again. 

They’ve decided to stay engaged until graduation, but the people around them can’t help meddling in their relationship. 

[Translated from [url=https://www.animategames.jp/home/detail/40009]animategames[/url]]
translation:
来自MIO的首部作品《浅梦浮生》的一个甜蜜而略带奇妙的故事，讲述了与人气角色高刀利光和伊织秀一郎共度的一年。

享受两篇小说风格的故事——一篇关于利光，一篇关于秀一郎——伴随他们走过恋爱的四季。


——利光线：与年下恋人的校园生活

经历了重重困难终于在一起后，利光和主人公现在是一对情侣了。

利光与心爱的前辈享受甜蜜校园生活的同时，还要抵挡她多管闲事的使魔和表弟，他幸福的生活是什么样的？


——秀一郎线：与年上恋人的同居生活

分开两年后，秀一郎和主人公重新开始了同居生活。

他们决定维持订婚状态直到毕业，但周围的人总是忍不住插手他们的关系。

[翻译自[url=https://www.animategames.jp/home/detail/40009]animategames[/url]]
